keyEvents.text: First Half begins.
Igor Matanovic (Freiburg) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Zeno Van den Bosch (Union Berlin) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
keyEvents.shortText: Zeno Van Den Bosch Yellow Card

keyEvents.text: Yannik Engelhardt (Freiburg) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
First Half ends, Freiburg 0, Union Berlin 0.
Substitution, Union Berlin. Jeong Woo-Yeong replaces Kastriot Imeri.
Substitution, Union Berlin. Oliver Burke replaces Tim Skarke.
Own Goal by Rani Khedira, Union Berlin. Freiburg 1, Union Berlin 0.

Goal! Freiburg 2, Union Berlin 0. Yuito Suzuki (Freiburg) right footed shot from the right side of the box to the centre of the goal. Assisted by Derry Scherhant with a through ball following a fast break.
Substitution, Freiburg. Keisuke Goto replaces Igor Matanovic.
Substitution, Union Berlin. Andrej Ilic replaces Livan Burcu.
Substitution, Freiburg. Vincenzo Grifo replaces Derry Scherhant.
Delay in match because of an injury Yannik Engelhardt (Freiburg).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Substitution, Freiburg. Patrick Osterhage replaces Yannik Engelhardt.
Substitution, Union Berlin. Linus Güther replaces Michel Aebischer.
Penalty saved. Vincenzo Grifo (Freiburg) right footed shot saved in the top right corner by Frederik Rønnow (Union Berlin).
Substitution, Freiburg. Lukas Kübler replaces Philipp Treu.
Substitution, Freiburg. Lucas Höler replaces Yuito Suzuki.
Substitution, Union Berlin. Tom Rothe replaces Derrick Köhn.
Jeong Woo-Yeong (Union Berlin) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
